postmortem: O1 four-gate evaluation — formal outcome vs scientific interpretability

relationship_to_the_formal_verdict.purpose: The formal verdict records what the frozen protocol returned. This records which of those returns carry information. They are different questions and must not be conflated.

gate_1_o1_owns_c1.consequence: The gate was arithmetically unpassable. A perfect O1 could have scored at most +0.009 against a +0.10 bar. It returns no information about O1.
gate_1_o1_owns_c1.cause: lost_after_leading was resolved to the EPISODE-level definition (lead held at some point AND final blue < final red). C1 was confirmed on WINDOW-level events (each red capture following a lead), whose prevalence was ~30%. The episode-level version has 0.9% prevalence and almost no variance. The ambiguity was identified and declared before data (experiments/o1_rollout.py docstring); the resolution chosen was wrong.

gate_2_g0_retains_an_anchor.consequence: The 'anchor' was dominated by episodes blue was losing throughout, so the gate compared who is better at games they never led — where O1 is indeed better (0.70 vs 0.45). That is not the anchor the protocol intended, which C1_PROPOSAL defined as 'ordinary attacking play with home secure'.

gate_3_selector_beats_best_fixed.defect: inherits the gate 1 / gate 2 population error
gate_3_selector_beats_best_fixed.consequence: Scored over populations built from the same faulty split; carries no independent information.

gate_4_behaviour_is_distinct.why_valid: Measured on matched observations at natural C1 onsets. No population split or outcome endpoint enters the statistic, so the defects above do not touch it.
gate_4_behaviour_is_distinct.reading: The cross-family difference is SMALLER than the 95th percentile of within-family seed-to-seed difference. This is not a near miss on a threshold; the family-level comparison went the wrong way. The O1 family sits inside the behavioral variability of ordinary training seeds.

root_cause.single_error: C1 was confirmed as a contrast WITHIN leading windows, using opportunity matching specifically to remove the 'blue was winning' confound. The gates operationalized it as a BETWEEN-EPISODE split on whether C1 ever fired, which is close to splitting on whether blue ever led — reintroducing exactly that confound.

visible_inversion.note: Under the gate populations, 'C1' became the region where G0 SUCCEEDS — the opposite of the premise.

harness_was_not_at_fault.conclusion: The paired-prefix mechanics worked as designed. The defect is in the population specification, not the implementation.

what_is_concluded.supported: This C1 response-oracle training procedure, under the frozen recipe used for O1, did not produce a reproducibly distinct behavioral family.
what_is_concluded.NOT_supported: That a C1 curriculum cannot produce a distinct strategy. One failed O1 family does not establish that.
what_is_concluded.NOT_supported_2: Anything about O1's C1 advantage or anchor trade-off. Gates 1-3 returned no information in either direction.
what_is_concluded.why_this_negative_is_stronger_than_prior: V6I22 and V6I26 failed with adapters or shared trunks, where collapse could be blamed on architecture. Here G0 and O1 are fully independent networks, freshly initialised, with O1 trained 100% from confirmed C1 starts — and the specialization signal still failed to exceed ordinary seed variation. A different training distribution alone was insufficient to make PPO settle into a distinct strategy family.
what_is_concluded.C1_confirmation_status: UNAFFECTED. It was a window-level within-leading contrast on its own fresh seeds and remains valid.

prohibited: rescuing O1 by re-running gates 1-3 with the window-level metric and treating the result as retention evidence
adjusting any threshold in the O1 protocol
birthing z1 on the strength of a corrected gate 1
citing gates 1-3 as evidence that O1 lacks a C1 advantage

permitted_exploratory_followup.question: Did O1 become a better policy in C1 without becoming a distinct strategy?
permitted_exploratory_followup.status_if_run: EXPLORATORY_POSTMORTEM — NOT A GATE — NOT RETENTION EVIDENCE
constraints: cannot change the NOT_RETAINED verdict, because gate 4 fails independently
permitted_exploratory_followup.why_it_cannot_change_the_decision: Even a clear window-level C1 advantage leaves gate 4 failing, and therefore no complementary strategy and no z1 birth.

engineering_lesson.rule: Keep contexts and outcomes at the same temporal level. A within-episode weakness must not be tested as 'episode ever had C > episode never had C'.
required_before_the_next_gate_run: factor the gate machinery into explicit OpportunityWindow / ContextOnset / OutcomeWindow / MatchedControl objects, so gates consume them directly instead of reconstructing context from episode-level booleans

add a preflight guard asserting that the gate population prevalence approximately matches the confirmation population prevalence; a shift from ~30% to 0.9% must abort before hours of evaluation, not be discovered afterwards

next_milestone.action: return to the ranked fallback weakness carrier_mostly_unescorted
next_milestone.requires: a brand-new preregistered window-level confirmation on fresh held-out seeds; it inherits nothing from C1's confirmation
next_milestone.do_not: train the next response oracle before that confirmation passes
